story.what_it_does: GMDC is a Gujarat-based mining and power company. In FY2025-26 it mined and sold about 78.84 lakh tonnes of lignite, earning roughly ₹2,339 crore from it, within mining segment revenue of ₹2,507.62 crore. It also runs a smaller power business with revenue of ₹215.72 crore.
story.plans: Management has set a lignite despatch target of 97 lakh tonnes for FY2026-27, well above the 78.84 lakh tonnes sold this year. It also lists operations at the Baitarni West coal block as a promise for FY2026.
story.moat: The notes do not describe a clear competitive moat. The Bhavnagar mine reached its highest annual despatch of 25.47 lakh tonnes, which shows the scale of its mining assets, but mining revenue fell versus the previous year and mine availability is a stress point.

scenarios.story: Mines deliver the higher despatch target of 97 lakh tonnes and the Baitarni West coal block starts operating, lifting recurring mining earnings. The power segment's turnaround also moves forward and narrows its loss.
signals_to_watch: Lignite despatch against the 97 lakh MT target for FY2026-27
Baitarni West coal block operations starting

scenarios.story: Lignite despatch improves somewhat but may again fall short of an ambitious target. Profit drops back from the ₹956.67 crore reported, since that figure was boosted by a one-time GST input tax credit of ₹492.63 crore.
signals_to_watch: Whether recurring earnings hold up without the one-time input tax credit
Power segment operating loss versus ₹79.61 crore

scenarios.story: Despatch misses targets again and mining revenue keeps declining, while the power segment loss widens further. Disputes and pending tax and court matters could add pressure.
signals_to_watch: Resolution of disputed GUVNL/GSECL receivables of ₹10.17 crore
Outcome of the Naini Coal bank guarantee case of ₹16.25 crore in court
